# Andrew Sheerin

> Product Design Leader. I translate ideas into understanding.

Plain-text mirrors of the public portfolio for crawlers, ATS tools, and AI agents.
Start with the briefing doc for role-fit assessment; use page mirrors for deeper evidence.

## Pages

- [Home](https://andrewsheerin.com/llms/home.md): Product design leader - editorial AI, behavioural design, and clarity from complexity.
- [Work](https://andrewsheerin.com/llms/work.md): Selected case studies: Antare, Citrix DONA, and VMware RabbitMQ.
- [Antare: Compressing Reality](https://andrewsheerin.com/llms/work-antare.md): Editorial intelligence for AI-generated incident feeds at Antare.
- [Citrix: The Hidden Cost of Good Intentions](https://andrewsheerin.com/llms/work-dona.md): Wellbeing meets productivity - behavioural science and Human-AI interaction at Citrix.
- [VMware: Designing Outside the Product](https://andrewsheerin.com/llms/work-education.md): RabbitMQ conversion - when the problem lived in education and enablement, not the product.
- [Design in Depth](https://andrewsheerin.com/llms/work-design-in-depth.md): Field notes on Antare event card decisions - density, affordances, and delayed corrections.
- [About](https://andrewsheerin.com/llms/about.md): Background, approach, and path from TerrorBull Games to product design leadership.
- [How I Work](https://andrewsheerin.com/llms/about-how-i-work.md): Four practices: ambiguity, shared understanding, naming hidden things, partnering with AI.
- [Origins](https://andrewsheerin.com/llms/about-origins.md): Before product design - TerrorBull Games, War on Terror, and persuasive communication through play.
- [Contact](https://andrewsheerin.com/llms/contact.md): Email, LinkedIn, and CV download.
